title: AgentExecutionResult
description: Phase 3.2-B data contract. The raw output of running the agent for one EvaluationRun -- the answer produced and the memory identifiers that were retrieved/selected along the way -- with NO metric or scoring fields. Deliberately excludes any evaluator_reference field or gold-comparison field: this operationalizes the requirement that the agent-execution path never imports or depends on EvaluatorReference (see boundary.py's validate_agent_visible(), whose signature likewise never accepts an EvaluatorReference argument, and AUDIT.md's finding that the historical reference_agent.py TaskRunner conflated agent execution with TSR scoring in one function -- this schema keeps them structurally separate: computing metrics from this artifact plus a separately-loaded EvaluatorReference is 3.2-C's job, not this object's).

run_id.description: Identifies which EvaluationRun this execution result belongs to.

task_id.description: Identifies which task was executed. Must match the EvaluationRun's task_id.

condition.description: Which controlled condition produced this result. Must match the EvaluationRun's condition.

agent_response.description: The raw answer/decision produced by the reasoning layer. Null if execution_status is not a completed status (e.g. ERROR).

selected_memory_ids.description: memory_ids that evidence selection chose for this task's reasoning context (the output of the selection layer, per CLEAN_AGENT_INTERFACES.md section 1). Empty for the NO_MEMORY condition. This is the agent's own record of what it used, not a gold-comparison result -- comparing it against EvaluatorReference.gold_evidence_ids (e.g. for strict TSR) is 3.2-C evaluator-side work, performed on a separately-loaded EvaluatorReference document, never inside this object.

retrieved_memory_ids.description: memory_ids surfaced by candidate discovery before reranking/selection narrowed them down. Distinguishing retrieved from selected supports the candidate-generation-vs-selection-capacity failure split required by EVALUATION_CONTRACT.md section 2 -- but this schema only records the IDs; computing the failure split itself is 3.2-C work.

reasoning_context_ref.description: Opaque reference to the AgentVisibleContext actually assembled and sent to the reasoning layer for this execution.

execution_status.description: Whether the agent execution completed. Not a correctness judgment -- SUCCESS means the pipeline ran to completion and produced a response, not that the response is correct (correctness is an EvaluationResult concern, not this object's).

error.description: Present only if execution_status is ERROR or TIMEOUT.

timing.description: Timing metadata for this execution, per REPRODUCIBILITY_CONTRACT.md's recording requirements.

trace_ref.description: Opaque reference to the TraceArtifact for this execution.
